messages:
incident-bot: :warning: routing-policy-eval errors spike detected in eu-west-1. route-errors=35% (5m). p95 latency jumped to ~2s
pagerduty: Paging on-call: john_sre (eu-west cluster)
john_sre: ack, looking now. pulling recent deploys and config changes
john_sre: anyone touch the policy schema or config in the last 2 hours?
anna_runtime: I rolled forward the schema migration at 2026-03-14T02:03 (schema v1.9 -> v2.0). It replaces use_legacy_variant_fallback with variant_behavior. Migration created variant_behavior.explicit_region_only=null for routes with no prior field.
luis_eng: can you paste the exact diff or snippet?
anna_runtime: patch:
```
- default: { use_legacy_variant_fallback: false }
+ default: { variant_behavior: { precedence: ["regional","global"], explicit_region_only: null } }
```
anna_runtime: the runtime policy-compiler coerces booleans and treats null as truthy in one codepath. That could be the source
marta_product: CS reports multiple EU customers saw model output from a different variant (content mismatch/higher hallucination). 3 tickets opened so far (ZD-4521, ZD-4523, ZD-4528)
kevin_cs: copying the sample from ZD-4521: user prompt -> completion from quantized-global-1b variant (we typically serve eu-2b). Looks lower fidelity
john_sre: hitting config service API for routing-policy: `curl -s https://config.prod.internal/v1/policies/routing-policy | jq .`
john_sre: several routes show `variant_behavior.explicit_region_only: null` for eu-west-1
john_sre: if null is being interpreted as true by the compiler, that would cause fallthrough to global variants? I thought true would mean explicit-only (no fallback)
luis_eng: our new semantics: explicit_region_only=true blocks fallback. But the compiler bug flips null -> true due to `if (value) {}` check and undefined/null truthiness.
anna_runtime: confirmed. The migration left null and the compiler treats null as true. So instead of blocking cross-region fallback, it ends up enabling an alternative fallback branch that picks global variants. Essentially inverted logic with absent-fields
john_sre: customers affected are in eu-west-1. Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) push cluster override to force explicit_region_only=false (so keep in-region); 2) revert schema migration; 3) fast patch to compiler. Which is fastest?
anna_runtime: fastest is an override at policy-service scale for eu-west-1. I can craft a redwoodctl command to set overrides.region.eu-west-1.variant_behavior.explicit_region_only=false
luis_eng: caution: setting false allows fallback to global variants again if in-region capacity not available. But current problem is incorrect selection of global quantized variant even when regional capacity is healthy. So forcing false will avoid the buggy truthy path. Agreed to apply override as temporary fix
john_sre: do a dry-run first. anna, paste the command
anna_runtime: dry-run:
```
redwoodctl policy update routing-policy --set overrides.region.eu-west-1.variant_behavior.explicit_region_only=false --env prod --dry-run
```
john_sre: dry-run OK. Applying now
ops-bot: policy-service rolling update started (canary=5%) by john_sre
deploy-bot: canary success (5%). Proceeding to 50%
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: overrides applied for eu-west-1 cluster
john_sre: monitoring metrics... route-errors dropping: 35% -> 9% in 4m
kevin_cs: ZD-4521 reporter confirms completions look normal now, latency back to baseline
marta_product: preliminary RCA: schema migration left explicit_region_only null -> compiler coercion bug flips semantics -> wrong variant selection -> customer-visible quality regression
anna_runtime: I am opening a hotfix PR to the compiler: PR 4021. Fixes boolean coercion to treat null/undefined as false, adds unit tests and migration helper that sets explicit_region_only=false when migrating older configs
luis_eng: also adding a pre-commit lint that rejects null for the new boolean fields and a CI gate to detect schema migrations that introduce null booleans
john_sre: recommending we also revert the schema change in config repo while patch lands. I'll run a safe revert and redeploy config-service.
ops-bot: config-service deploy started by john_sre
deploy-bot: config-service deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:
john_sre: confirmed config rollback shows explicit_region_only=false set for eu-west-1 routes
john_sre: metrics stable: route-errors < 5% for 10m across monitored routes. Incident bot cleared
incident-bot: RESOLVED: route-errors below threshold for 15m. Auto-close scheduled
kevin_cs: I'll follow up with affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps. Adding PR/patch references in the CS note
marta_product: postmortem owner: @anna_runtime. Actions:
 - anna_runtime: land compiler PR 4021 + migration helper + tests
 - luis_eng: add config lint rule + CI check
 - ops: add schema-migration canary validation for boolean semantics
 - cs: customer outreach + log of affected request ids
 - product: update runbook about schema migrations and policy semantics
anna_runtime: taking postmortem, ETA EOD today for draft
john_sre: great response, good cross-team coordination. Closing once postmortem link posted
ops: incident severity: Sev2 closed by john_sre
john_sre: :white_check_mark: closing thread. Huge thanks to everyone for quick override and rollback. Keep an eye on related CI runs and lint rule rollout
